Standard discrete Morse CW equivalence, cofiber of edge-star attachment and integer long exact sequence prove the full homotopy response, map and primitive ±1 connecting degree. The result is finite, not a numerical extrapolation.

value.rationale: The first seven-cycle three-color categorical product in a published homotopy question has adjacent-dimensional free homology. A single graph-edge fault is a minimally supported perturbation. The proved primitive 4-cell attachment eliminates its sole integral degree-three class while preserving all three degree-four summands, for every edge. This differentiates a nontrivial actual inclusion map from any mere change in Euler characteristic; it is a natural fault-stability datum, not a random graph enumeration.
